title: polyscan scan / dast / ports report
description: Written by `polyscan scan --json`, `polyscan dast --json` and `polyscan ports --json`.

polyscan.description: polyscan version that wrote the file.

generated.description: When the report was written, UTC.

languages.description: Detected languages and how many files each.

status.description: ok = ran and its findings are complete. error = it FAILED: absence of findings proves nothing. unavailable = not installed. skipped = not relevant here (detail says why).

items.description: One check and whether it really ran. An importer must show error/unavailable as a gap, never as 'clean'.

tool.description: Which check found it: semgrep, gitleaks, osv-scanner, bandit, npm-audit, cargo-audit, composer-audit, progpilot, spotbugs, db-config, trivy, checkov, zap, testssl, ss.

severity.description: The tool's own severity, mapped to these five levels.

rule.description: The rule or advisory id: B608, CVE-2021-44228, GHSA-..., polyscan-db-weak-password, 10038 (ZAP)...

message.description: What is wrong, in the tool's words. Untrusted text: escape it before showing it in HTML.

file.description: Path relative to the scanned folder; for a site scan the URL; for a host check address:port.

line.description: 1-based line, or 0 when unknown (dependencies, URLs). Never a guessed 1.

category.description: Kind of problem; drives the risk model.

language.description: python, javascript, java, php, rust, docker, terraform, database, or empty.

snippet.description: The code line, with the VALUE of any secret replaced by [redacted]. Untrusted text.

cwe.description: Weakness ids reported by the tool, comma-separated; empty when the tool gives none.
